privacy.intro: At JBDev (Jordi Barrachina Méndez) we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacy.p1_desc: We collect the basic information necessary to create your account (email, first and last name) and ensure the proper functioning of the authentication system, operated securely.
privacy.p2_desc: The system is designed to separate the voter's identity from their vote. Your participation (the fact that you have voted) is recorded for quorum purposes, but the option you have chosen is stored completely anonymously. We save a local cryptographic hash on your device as a receipt.
privacy.p3_desc: We use your data solely to manage your access, send notifications related to assemblies, and provide the app's services. We do not share your data with third parties for advertising purposes.
privacy.p4_desc: We retain your data as long as your account is active. You can permanently delete your account from the Settings section, which will erase your personal data. Votes already cast will remain in the tally anonymously to guarantee the integrity of past results.
privacy.p5_desc: We implement industry-standard security measures, including secure databases (Supabase) and encrypted connections to protect your information against unauthorized access.
privacy.p6_desc: If you have questions about the processing of your data or want to exercise your rights (access, rectification, deletion), contact us at: jordibarrachinam@gmail.com

terms.intro: Welcome to quorum / quorum Pro. These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of our mobile application, provided by JBDev (Jordi Barrachina Méndez).
terms.p1_desc: By accessing and using this application, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree with any part, you may not use our service.
terms.p2_desc: The application provides a platform for managing digital assemblies and voting. It includes a cryptographic safe box system to guarantee the integrity of anonymous voting.
terms.p3_desc: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and login credentials. You must notify us immediately of any security breach.
terms.p4_desc: You agree to use the platform in a civic, legal manner and without violating the rights of other users. It is prohibited to attempt to fraudulently alter voting results.
terms.p5_desc: JBDev (Jordi Barrachina Méndez) is not responsible for decisions made in assemblies hosted on the platform, nor for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from its use.
terms.p6_desc: These Terms are governed by the laws of Spain. Any dispute will be submitted to the competent courts of said jurisdiction.
terms.p7_desc: For any questions about these Terms, you can contact us at: jordibarrachinam@gmail.com
